summary: M2.S4 (D-025) Matching Engine + Lead Scoring AI fully tested. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed (6 unit tests on compute_match + 11 API tests on /matches and /matches/lead-score). Frontend: MatchesPage card list, min_score filter, navigation, MatchLeadScorePage banner (ROVENTE 92/100, engine=gemini-3-flash), action_hint dark card, 4 reasons with ✓, collapsible breakdown — all verified. Sidebar 'Match' active and clickable. Italian AI output natural.

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Cause: i18n t('matches.warm') etc. is rendered inside <option> and the Emergent dev instrumentation wraps the dynamic text in a <span data-ve-dynamic>. Functionally harmless (select works), but generates a noisy console error on every Matches page load. Suggestion: use a string-only label, e.g. `${t('matches.warm') ?? 'tiepidi'}` concatenated via template literal so the <option> child is a single text node, or move the label OUTSIDE the option (keep <option> with bare value).

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): silence the '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' React warning on MatchesPage by joining the dynamic option label as a single text node (e.g. `{`40+ ${t('matches.warm') || 'tiepidi'}`}` outside the JSX expression chain).

OBSERVATION: with current seed (Andrea↔Roma + 1 more) all visible matches are ≥85, so changing min_score 40/50/65/85 yields the same 2 cards. To exercise the empty-state UI (data-testid='matches-empty') in production, seed at least one client whose score is in 40-64 range, or add a temporary test-only client with city mismatch.
critical_code_review_comments: matching.py — weights sum exactly to 100 (asserted in tests). Hard-incompatibility on operation correctly short-circuits to score=0 with full zero breakdown. Soft scoring on price overshoot (≤10% → linear, ≤30% → 25%, >30% → 0) is sensible.
matches.py — 4 endpoints clean and mongo `_id` excluded. Multi-tenant filter via agency_id on every query. Seller/landlord short-circuit with info='client_type_does_not_search' is graceful.

lead_scoring.py — Robust try/except wraps the whole Gemini path; rule-based fallback returns same JSON shape with engine='rule-based'. JSON parsing strips ```json fences. Score is clamped [0,100], reasons truncated to 4 × 200char. Strong implementation.

MatchLeadScorePage.jsx — clean separation of loading/error/data states; testids leadscore-loading/leadscore-error/leadscore-banner/leadscore-action all present. Engine label visible in banner (good for debugging).

MatchesPage.jsx line 64-67 — `<option value={40}>40+ {t('matches.warm') || 'tiepidi'}</option>` triggers React hydration warning because the dev tooling wraps the dynamic <span>. Pure JS workaround: build label string outside JSX. Non-blocking.
